newsitem.title: UK: LME copper lower in evening trade.
newsitem.headline: LME copper lower in evening trade.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) copper prices tested the lower end of their current trading range during evening inter-office trading but other metals were barely disturbed.
Traders said a softer Comex coupled with market talk that LME warehouse copper stocks may shows a rise on Tuesday had prompted light selling and liquidation orders.

By 1900 GMT three months delivery copper was indicated at $2,179/$2,183 after having attracted sufficient support around the $2,180 level to prevent a further break-down in values. A move below this level may have touched off sell-stops in early Tuesday trade. Nickel, the day's biggest mover, was a much calmer market in the evening and was indicated around $6,850/$6,870 a tonne.
